name: edgartools
description: Query and analyze SEC filings using EdgarTools -- company profiles, financials, filings, ownership, full-text search.
long_description: Exposes EdgarTools as MCP tools for researching SEC filings: company profiles and financials, filing search and retrieval, ownership/insider data, proxy statements, fund data, screening, trend analysis, and cross-company comparison. Reads only -- makes no filings or submissions.

edgar_identity.title: SEC EDGAR Identity
edgar_identity.description: Required by SEC: your name and email, e.g. 'Jane Doe jane.doe@example.com'
